# Problem Statement

A particle of mass $m$ moves freely inside a one-dimensional infinite potential well of length $a$.

The normalized energy eigenfunctions are:

$$
\phi_n(x)=\sqrt{\frac{2}{a}}
\sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{a}\right)
$$

with corresponding energy eigenvalues:

$$
E_n=\frac{n^2\pi^2\hbar^2}{2ma^2}
$$

At time $t=0$, the particle has the initial wavefunction

$$
\psi(x,0)=
\frac{A}{\sqrt a}\sin\left(\frac{\pi x}{a}\right)
+
\sqrt{\frac{3}{5a}}
\sin\left(\frac{3\pi x}{a}\right)
+
\frac{1}{\sqrt{5a}}
\sin\left(\frac{5\pi x}{a}\right)
$$

where $A$ is a real constant.
